blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing approaches to multi-view spatial reasoning operate largely on sparse input views. Vision-language models (VLMs) are thus restricted to understand a scene and infer spatial relations within these fixed views, leading to fragile cross-view alignment and geometry-to-language bottleneck. To address these issues, we formulate a novel Seek-and-View reasoning approach to find implicit cross-view spatial evidence by locating a question-relevant view to support the spatial reasoning. To realize this approach, we propose Vantage, a training-free model-agnostic reasoning framework that pairs a VLM with a 3D foundation model: a viewpoint-grounded reasoning stage for question analysis and view planning, followed by a geometry-grounded evidence augmentation stage to effectively synthesize and incorporate visual evidence into the final reasoning. Comprehensive experiments on six VLMs demonstrate consistent improvements on five benchmarks without fine-tuning. Overall, by revealing spatial evidence through view-grounded reasoning, Vantage can largely reduce reliance on language-based cross-view alignment and improve multi-view spatial understanding. Our code is available at https://github.com/q1xiangchen/Vantage.
blocks.zh: 现有多视图空间推理方法主要以稀疏的投入观点运作。 因此,视觉语言模型(VLMs)被限制在这些固定视图中理解一个场景并推断空间关系,从而导致脆弱的交叉视图对接和几何对语言瓶颈. 为了解决这些问题,我们制定了一部小说《探索与观察》推理法,通过定位与问题有关的观点来寻找隐含的交叉视野空间证据,以支持空间推理。 为了实现这个方法,我们提议万塔奇(Vantage),一个没有训练的模型-不可知推理框架,将VLM与3D基础模型配对:一个基于观点的推理阶段,用于问题分析和观点规划,然后是几何基础的证据增强阶段,以有效综合视觉证据,并将其纳入最终推理. 6个甚高频综合试验显示,在5个基准上不断改进,但没有微调。 总体而言,通过基于视图的推理揭示空间证据,万塔奇可以在很大程度上减少对基于语言的交叉视图对齐的依赖,提高多视图空间理解. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/q1xiangchen/Vantage上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multi-view spatial understanding [ 10 , 47 , 39 , 19 ] requires models to capture the structure of a scene from partial observations that are fixed and sparse.
Accurate cross-view alignment is therefore essential.
Especially, spatial questions cannot be answered simply from individual views and instead require associating evidence from different views.
Despite rapid progress in vision-language models (VLMs), their spatial reasoning over multiple views remains limited and prone to hallucination [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh:
多视角空间理解[10,47,39,19]需要模型从固定和稀有的部分观测中捕捉出场景的结构.
因此,准确的交叉观点一致至关重要。
特别是,空间问题不能简单地从个人观点来回答,而需要将不同观点的证据联系起来。
尽管视觉语言模型(VLMs)取得了迅速的进展,但其空间推理相对于多种观点仍然有限并容易产生幻觉[9].

blocks.en:
Recent VLMs therefore seek to strengthen geometric reasoning capabilities by verbalizing the geometry during reasoning [ 19 , 16 , 24 ] or by injecting geometric priors into the model [ 55 , 49 , 13 ] , both aimed at improving the model’s awareness of the underlying scene structure (see the illustrations in Figure 1 (a)).
While improving over shallow visual recognition, both approaches rely on the VLM to align views and perform the reasoning explicitly in language, leading to the following two issues.
First is fragile cross-view alignment . Strong semantic and contextual reasoning ability does not inherently enforce structured and globally consistent geometric constraints required across views, leaving the alignment implicit and error-prone.
Second is the geometry-to-language bottleneck . Upon compressing the spatial geometry into discrete semantic descriptions, the reasoning would potentially overlook fine-grained spatial information [ 4 , 41 , 5 ] .
More fundamentally, both approaches remain within a View-and-Reason paradigm, in which the reasoning is fixed on the given observations.
Humans, in contrast, can conceptualize the three-dimensional structure of a scene and seek a view to reveal the visible information for resolving the spatial relation.
Such a visual thinking process leads us to ask: Can a model decide where to look, then reason better from that view?
blocks.zh:
因此,最近的VLM试图加强几何推理能力,在推理过程中将几何语言[19,16,24]或将几何前缀注入模型[55,49,13],两者都旨在提高模型对基本场景结构的认识(见图1(a)中的插图).
这两种方法虽然改进了浅显的视觉识别,但都依靠虚拟LM来统一观点,并明确用语言进行推理,导致以下两个问题。
首先是脆弱的交叉视图对接。 强烈的语义和背景推理能力在本质上并没有强制实施各种观点所要求的结构化和全球一致的几何限制,使校正隐含并容易出错。
二是几何对语言的瓶颈. . 将空间几何压缩成离散语义描述后,推理可能会忽略细微的空间信息[4,41,5].
更根本的是,这两种方法都停留在View-and-Reason范式中,其中推理固定在给定的观察上.
相形之下,人类可以概念化一个场景的三维结构,并寻求一个视图来揭示用于解决空间关系的可见信息.
这种视觉思维过程导致我们问: 模特儿能决定看哪里吗? 从这个角度讲理由更好?

Figure 1: (a) Existing approaches reason over fixed views, suffering from fragile cross-view alignment and the geometry-to-language bottleneck.
(b) Our novel Seek-and-View reasoning paradigm seeks a question-relevant view (see bottom right) to make the spatial evidence directly observable.
blocks.zh:
图1 (a) 现有方法与固定观点相比是有道理的,它们受到脆弱的交叉视图调整和几何对语言瓶颈的影响。
(b) 我们的小说《探索与展望》推理范式寻求与问题相关的观点(见下方右侧),使空间证据直接被观察。

blocks.en:
To explore this idea,
we formulate a novel Seek-and-View paradigm, in which a model first seeks a viewpoint that consolidates evidence from different views into an observation for supporting the spatial reasoning.
Our new paradigm alleviates the burden on semantic textual reasoning for global scene understanding through question-relevant, evidence-seeking, and reasoning-oriented visual evidence acquisition.
Recent studies explore a think-with-image paradigm for visual question answering (VQA), where the model reasons with additional visual cues obtained by zooming, drawing auxiliary lines, or estimating depth [ 11 , 31 , 27 , 29 , 41 , 12 ] .
Yet, the underlying visual thoughts are still an in-view understanding confined to the fixed observations.
Beyond fixed observations, we aim to realize a Seek-and-View paradigm, in which the challenges are
(i) to locate a question-relevant viewpoint, and
(ii) to effectively contextualize the acquired visual evidence for subsequent reasoning.
blocks.zh:
为了探索这个想法,
我们提出一个小说"探索与观察"的范式,在这个范式中,一个模型首先寻求一种观点,将来自不同观点的证据整合为支持空间推理的观察.
我们的新模式通过与问题相关、寻求证据和以推理为导向的视觉证据的获取,减轻了语义文字推理对全球场景理解的负担。
最近的研究探索了视觉问题回答(VQA)的思维-图像范式,其中模型原因加上通过缩放,绘制辅助线条,或估计深度[11,31,27,29,41,12]获得的额外视觉提示.
然而,基本的视觉思想仍然是限于固定观察的内视理解.
除了固定的观察之外,我们的目标是实现一个探索和观察的范式,其中的挑战是:
(一) 找到与问题有关的观点,以及
(二) 有效地将获得的视觉证据的背景化,以便随后进行推理。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose Vantage , a two-stage training-free and model-agnostic framework that instantiates the Seek-and-View paradigm by incorporating a VLM with a 3D foundation model (3DFM).
In the first viewpoint-grounded reasoning stage, the VLM analyzes the question to identify the necessary observation(s) and plans a viewpoint to acquire the intended evidence.
In the second geometry-grounded evidence augmentation stage, the 3DFM produces a new view of the scene and takes it with the given question and proper guidance to support the final VLM reasoning.
In this way, the 3DFM externalizes the cross-view alignment by reconstructing a consistent scene representation, meanwhile the VLM plans the viewpoint and continues reasoning with the additional visual evidence acquired from the new view; see Figure 1 (b).
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们提议万塔奇(Vantage),一个无培训的、模型不可知的两阶段框架,通过纳入一个具有3D基础模型的VLM(3DFM),来即时取出"探索与视觉"范式.
在第一个基于观点的推理阶段,VLM对问题进行分析,以确定必要的观察,并计划获得预期证据的观点。
在第二个几何地基证据增强阶段,3DFM生成了新的场景取景,并带有给定的问题和适当的指导,以支持最终的VLM推理.
通过这种方式,3DFM通过重建一致的场景代表来将交叉视图对接外部化,而VLM则用从新视角获取的额外视觉证据来规划观点并继续进行推理;见图1(b).

blocks.en:
Our evaluations focus on multi-view spatial VQA tasks whose answers are determined by the geometric relations within static real-world scenes.
Across five spatial reasoning benchmarks and six different VLMs, Vantage is able to consistently boost the performance of all the six VLMs without any fine-tuning, with a mean accuracy gain of 6.7%.
These results highlight that the difficulty in current multi-view spatial understanding stems not only from limited geometric reasoning capability but also from passive reasoning on fixed input observations.
Further, we analyze failure cases and reveal the other limitations of existing VLMs.
Our main contributions are threefold: • We introduce a novel Seek-and-View reasoning paradigm for multi-view spatial understanding, in which we propose to seek cross-view spatial evidence through a question-relevant viewpoint rather than reasoning solely on fixed input observations. • We propose Vantage, a two-stage training-free framework to realize Seek-and-View with a viewpoint-grounded reasoning and a geometry-grounded evidence augmentation, explicitly coupling VLM reasoning with a 3D foundation model. • Through extensive experiments across six VLMs and five benchmarks, we demonstrate the effectiveness of Seek-and-View, revealing its strength to boost the VLM performance and also the limitations of existing VLMs under this reasoning paradigm.
blocks.zh:
我们的评价侧重于多视图空间VQA任务,其答案由静态现实世界场景中的几何关系决定.
在5个空间推理基准和6个不同的VLM中,万塔奇能够持续地提升所有6个VLM的性能而无需微调,平均精度增益为6.7%。
这些结果凸显出当前多视空间理解的难度不仅出自于有限的几何推理能力,还出自于对固定输入观测的被动推理.
此外,我们分析失败案例,并揭示现有甚高频的其他局限性。
• 我们的主要贡献有三: 我们引入了一部小说"探索与视觉"的多视角空间理解推理范式,其中我们建议通过一个与问题相关的观点来寻找交叉视角的空间证据,而不是仅仅通过固定输入观测来进行推理. 我们提出万塔奇,一个无培训的两阶段框架,以基于观点的推理和几何证据的增强实现Def-and-View,明确将VLM推理与3D基础模型相接. • 通过对6个甚高频和5个基准的广泛试验,我们展示了 " 探索与视频 " 的有效性,揭示了其在提高甚高频性能方面的实力,以及这一推理范式下现有甚高频的局限性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Existing research has enhanced VLMs for multi-view spatial reasoning largely in two directions.
The first verbalizes scene geometry into textual or symbolic structures, such as cognitive maps, scene graphs, or bounding boxes to support downstream reasoning [ 23 , 19 , 39 , 24 , 32 , 1 , 6 , 8 ] .
This approach, however, demands labor-intensive per-scene annotations and subsequent supervised fine-tuning.
The second direction injects geometric priors directly into the model [ 35 , 55 , 15 , 13 , 48 , 49 ] , e.g . , by fusing features from geometric encoders, redesigning positional encoding with 3D coordinates, or introducing reconstructive training objectives.
Despite these advances, the visual observations are typically fixed, leaving the model to reason over a predetermined set of views.
In contrast, our Seek-and-View reasoning paradigm adapts the observation itself by acquiring a task-specific view tailored to the question, while keeping the core VLM training-free.
blocks.zh:
现有的研究主要在两个方向上加强了多视角空间推理的VLM.
第一种口语将场景几何化为文字或符号结构,如认知图,场景图,或边框来支持下游推理[23,19,39,24,32,1,6,8].
然而,这种办法需要劳动密集型的人均场面说明和随后监督的微调。
第二个方向直接向模型中注入几何前缀[35,55,15,13,48,49],例如,通过从几何编码器中引信特征,重新设计有3D坐标的位置编码,或者引入重建训练目标.
尽管取得了这些进步,但视觉观察通常还是固定的,使模型比预先确定的一系列观点更具有理性.
与此相反,我们探索和观察推理范式通过获取针对问题的具体任务观点来调整观察本身,同时保持核心的VLM培训自由.

blocks.en:
Thinking with images [ 27 ] is an emerging paradigm that externalizes intermediate reasoning into visual operations such as sketching, marking, zooming, and depth estimation for mathematical geometry and 2D spatial tasks [ 11 , 31 , 14 , 29 , 51 , 46 , 21 , 41 , 20 ] .
Related agentic approaches further treat the VLM as a tool-calling agent, augmenting reasoning via various external tools [ 5 , 3 , 7 , 38 ] .
blocks.zh:
与图像相思[27]是一个新兴的范式,将中间推理外部化为视觉操作,如为数学几何和2D空间任务进行素描,标记,缩放和深度估计[11,31,14,29,51,46,21,41,20].
相关的代理方法进一步将VLM视为一种取用工具的代理,通过各种外部工具增强推理[5、3、7、38]。

blocks.en:
Spatial reasoning can leverage a world model to generate unseen observations for iterative exploration [ 45 , 2 , 50 , 56 , 26 , 52 , 12 ] .
This approach, however, incurs substantial inference cost, while requiring dedicated fine-tuning to maintain cross-view consistency.
Other approaches [ 43 , 54 , 17 ] construct stitched panoramic views or top-down scene representations to try to preserve the scene consistency.
Yet, these representations are typically generated as generic global views, rather than tailored to expose the spatial evidence needed for a specific question.
Our approach instead performs a question-relevant view seeking, allowing the geometric backend to acquire the desired visual evidence to support the subsequent spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh:
空间推理可以利用一个世界模型生成不可见的观测结果来进行迭代探索[45、2、50、56、26、52、12]。
然而,这种办法需要大量推论费用,同时需要专门微调,以保持交叉观点的一致性。
其它方法[43,54,17]构建了被缝合的全景或自上而下场景表现来试图保持场景的一致性.
然而,这些表述通常是作为通用的全球观点产生的,而不是专门用来揭露特定问题所需的空间证据。
相反,我们的做法是一种与问题有关的观点,使几何后端能够获得所需的视觉证据,以支持随后的空间推理。

blocks.en:
Recent 3D foundation models (3DFMs) [ 36 , 25 , 40 , 37 ] have made feed-forward recovery of scene geometry increasingly practical.
G3T [ 18 ] further introduces gravity-aligned point maps, providing an upright scene coordinate frame.
By reconstructing a consistent scene representation and estimating camera poses, 3DFMs externalize the cross-view alignment and allow viewpoint planning and view synthesis of the scene.
Such a view synthesis differs from conventional novel view synthesis, which aims to faithfully render a scene from a specified pose.
Our setting instead seeks a viewpoint mainly for exposing the spatial evidence to support the reasoning.
Hence, the synthesized view need not be photorealistic.
Its core value is to preserve the underlying scene and reveal necessary visual evidence needed for answering the given question.
blocks.zh:
最近的三维地基模型(3DFMs)[36,25,40,37]使得地貌几何的进取回越来越实用.
G3T [18]进一步引入了重力相通点图,提供了直立的场景坐标框架.
通过重建一致的场景表现和估计相机外观,3DFM将相机对接外部化,并允许对场景进行视角规划和视图合成.
这种观点合成与传统新观点合成不同,后者旨在将场景从指定的姿势上忠实地渲染出.
相反,我们的设定主要是为了披露空间证据来支持推理。
因此,综合视图不必是光现实主义的.
它的核心价值是保存基本场景并揭示回答特定问题所需的视觉证据.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Vantage is a two-stage pipeline, as shown in Figure 2 .
Its name reflects the key idea, i.e . , the model seeks a vantage viewpoint from which the spatial relation relevant to answering the given question can become visible to support the reasoning.
In this section, we first overview the Seek-and-View reasoning paradigm in Section 3.1 , followed by the method details in Sections 3.2 and 3.3 .
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,车站是两相管道。
其名称反映了关键的想法,即: 该模型寻求一种有利的观点,从中可以看到与回答所给出的问题相关的空间关系,以支持推理.
在本节中,我们首先概述第3.1节的 " 探索与观察 " 推理范式,然后概述第3.2和3.3节的方法细节。

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview of Seek-and-View Reasoning Paradigm
blocks.zh: 3.1 寻求和观察理性范例概述

blocks.en:
Given a spatial question q q and a set of sparse, unposed input views 𝒱 = { v i } i = 1 N \mathcal{V}=\{v_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} , we consider visual question answering (VQA), in which the observed input views 𝒱 \mathcal{V} collectively provide the scene information for answering question q q .
However, the relevant spatial relation for answering question q q may not be directly observable solely from any individual view in 𝒱 \mathcal{V} .
blocks.zh:
鉴于一个空间问题 q q 和一组稀有的,未配置的输入视图 V = { i=一个 N\ mathcal{V}=\{v_{i}\}_{i=i=i=1}^{N},我们考虑视觉问题回答(VQA),其中所观察到的输入视图 V\mathcal{V}共同提供场景信息,用于回答问题q q.
然而,仅从V\mathcal{V}中的任何个人观点,可能无法直接观察到回答问题qq的相关空间关系.

blocks.en:
Directly using a VLM to predict the camera pose of the target view is unreliable [ 52 ] .
Yet, introducing a metric 3D coordinate system could further escalate the uncertainty in scale, orientation, and alignment.
We thus formulate view planning as a relative camera action grounded in one of the observed views to more reliably control the viewpoint.
A reasoner ℋ \mathcal{H} analyzes the question q q and available observations 𝒱 \mathcal{V} to select a reference view v r v_{r} and a relative camera action Δ ​ v \Delta v , while retaining intermediate reasoning contexts for subsequent answer prediction: ℋ ⁡ ( q , 𝒱 ) → ( v r , Δ ​ v , c ana , c guide ) , \mathcal{H}(q,\mathcal{V})\rightarrow(v_{r},\Delta v,c_{\mathrm{ana}},c_{\mathrm{guide}}), (1) where c ana c_{\mathrm{ana}} captures the question-oriented analysis of the current observations, and c guide c_{\mathrm{guide}} contains the planned view adjustment and its underlying rationale.
blocks.zh:
直接使用VLM来预测目标视图的相机姿势是不可靠的 [52].
然而,采用衡量三维坐标系统可能会使规模、取向和调整方面的不确定性进一步升级。
因此,我们把规划视为一个相对的相机行动,以观测到的观点之一为基础,更可靠地控制观点。

blocks.en:
Before answering the input question q q , we obtain the view through a geometry-grounded synthesis: a 3D foundation model reconstructs the scene and its camera poses from the unposed input views 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , and the planned action Δ ​ v \Delta v is applied to the reference view v r v_{r} to reproject the reconstruction to produce the requested view v s v_{s} .
The synthesized view v s v_{s} is then incorporated into the original VQA ( q , 𝒱 ) (q,\mathcal{V}) , together with the intermediate reasoning contexts ( c ana , c guide ) (c_{\mathrm{ana}},c_{\mathrm{guide}}) , to support the subsequent spatial reasoning.
We detail the reconstruction and reprojection in Section 3.3 .

blocks.en: 3.2 Viewpoint-Grounded Reasoning
blocks.zh: 3.2 取景点组合

blocks.en:
Instead of unconstrained reasoning, we structure view planning around question analysis and action planning in viewpoint-aware perspective.
In this way, we can resolve spatial relations not directly observable from any individual view and determine how to adjust the viewpoint to reveal the spatial relations.
However, grounding such semantic reasoning into an executable camera action remains challenging.
We therefore decompose viewpoint-grounded reasoning into the following two steps:
blocks.zh:
我们结构上不拘泥于推理,而是从认识的角度看待问题分析和行动规划。
这样,我们就可以解决从任何个人角度无法直接观察到的空间关系,并确定如何调整观点来揭示空间关系.
然而,将这种语义推理作为可执行相机行动的基础仍然具有挑战性。
因此,我们将基于观点的推理分为以下两个步骤:

blocks.en:
Question analysis: Establishing a semantic directional frame from the reference view. A natural starting point for multi-view reasoning is to find a view whose scene contents are most relevant to the question.
Here, we employ a VLM to first select a reference view v r v_{r} from the input views 𝒱 \mathcal{V} conditioned on the question q q .
It then then identifies the anchor entity, namely the camera viewpoint, object, or region in the reference view that constitutes one side of the queried spatial relation.
Directional terms such as left, right, front, and behind may refer to different frames of reference while sharing the same linguistic expressions [ 44 , 39 ] .
This creates ambiguity in how a directional relation should be spatially grounded.
To reduce this ambiguity, the VLM establishes a semantic directional frame grounded in reference view v r v_{r} . By default, the forward direction of v r v_{r} is treated as north, unless an explicit directional convention is specified by the question. This semantic frame is maintained throughout the reasoning process to provide a consistent interpretation of directional relations without requiring explicit metric 3D coordinates.
blocks.zh:
问题分析: 从参考角度建立语义取向框架. 多视图推理的一个自然起点是找到一个其场景内容与问题最相干的观点.
在此, 我们使用 VLM 来首先从输入视图 V\ mathcal{V} 中选择一个引用视图 v r\\ v\r}, 其条件为 q q 。
然后在参考视图中确定锚地实体,即构成被询问空间关系的一面的相机视角、物体或区域。
方向名词如左,右,前,后等可以指不同的参考框架,同时共享相同的语言表达 [44,39].
这造成方向关系应如何以空间为基础方面的模糊性。
为了减少这一模糊性,VLM建立了一个基于参考视图vrv_{r}的语义取向框架. 默认情况下,v r v_{r}的前进方向被视作向北,除非问题指定了明确的方向公约. 这一语义框架在整个推理过程中都得到维护,以便对方向关系提供一致的解释而不需要明确的公分量3D坐标.

blocks.en:
Resolving Spatial Relations into Observation Needs. The VLM identifies the queried entity or region and the spatial relation with respect to the anchor. It then resolves this relation within the established semantic directional frame, translating object-relative or camera-relative directions into a unified scene direction; see Figure 2 (Stage 1).
From the reference view v r v_{r} , the model examines the currently visible evidence and determines which spatial relation remains visible or verifiable.
Together, these elements form the question analysis context c ana c_{\mathrm{ana}} , which summarizes the problem diagnosis and provides the reasoning basis for subsequent viewpoint planning.
blocks.zh:
将空间关系纳入观测需求。 VLM识别被询问的实体或区域以及与锚的空间关系. 然后在既定的语义取向框内解决了这种关系,将对象相接或相机相接取向转化为统一的场景取向;见图2(图一).
从参考视图v r v_{r},模型审查目前可见的证据,并确定哪些空间关系仍然可见或可核查.
这些要素共同构成了问题分析背景c aa c_{\mathrm{ana}}},它总结了问题诊断,并为后续观点规划提供了推理基础.

blocks.en:
View Planning: From Observation Need to Camera Action. The observation need identified above is then translated into a camera action. However, it is expressed semantically, whereas acquiring a new view requires a camera pose defined in the reconstructed 3D space.
We therefore provide the VLM with a predefined action set of 17 camera motions spanning rotation, translation, and hybrid transformations, each parameterized by three coarse magnitude levels: small, medium, and large. For example, a rightward rotation corresponds to 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} , 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} , and 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} , respectively. Conditioned on question q q , input views 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , question analysis context c ana c_{\mathrm{ana}} , and an action-planning prompt that specifies this action set, the VLM predicts a camera adjustment relative to the reference view v r v_{r} : Δ ​ v = ( π , μ ) , \Delta v=(\pi,\mu), (2) where π \pi denotes the selected camera action and μ \mu its magnitude level.
After the 3DFM estimates the pose of the reference view, the geometric backend maps Δ ​ v \Delta v to the corresponding numerical pose transformation in the reconstructed coordinate frame. This structured interface allows the VLM to reason about how to adjust the viewpoint without directly predicting the metric camera pose, while leaving precise geometric grounding to the reconstruction backend.
Section 4.3 shows the benefit of this structured action interface and the Appendix provides the action set and planning prompt.

blocks.en:
Preserving the Reasoning Context. The synthesized view alone does not convey why the viewpoint was selected or which spatial cues should be examined. To explicitly convey this planning intent [ 38 ] , the VLM also generates the reasoning guidance context c guide c_{\mathrm{guide}} within the same view planning call.
The guidance describes the expected spatial configuration, identifies relevant visual anchors in the input views, and specifies the spatial cues to inspect or combine in the synthesized view. Since it is generated before view synthesis, it records the intended use of the new observation without assuming that the expected evidence is present.
The resulting c guide c_{\mathrm{guide}} is passed to the final VQA stage as auxiliary context, preserving the connection between the planned observation and the original visual evidence.

由此而来c-_{\mathrm{guide}}}被传递到最后的VQA阶段作为辅助上下文,保留了计划中的观察与原始视觉证据之间的联系.

blocks.en: 3.3 Geometry-Grounded Evidence Augmentation
blocks.zh: 3.3 几何-环形证据增强

blocks.en: In this stage, we ground the planned viewpoint in the reconstructed 3D scene to synthesize the view. We then use this geometry-grounded observation with proper guidance from the previous stage to augment the original VQA for continuous reasoning through the following two steps.
blocks.zh: 在这个阶段,我们把规划的视角 放在重建的三维场景中,以综合该视图。 然后,我们用上一个阶段的正确指导来使用这种几何定位的观察,通过以下两个步骤来增强原VQA的连续推理.

blocks.en:
View Synthesis: Realizing the Requested Observation. It is important that the planned semantic action preserves its intended orientation with respect to the ground plane. For example, the action in Figure 2 requires the camera to pan 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} to the right while remaining horizontally aligned with the ground plane.
This motivates gravity-aligning the reconstructed scene to provide a canonical world frame for converting semantic actions into geometric camera transformations.
The 3DFM 𝒢 \mathcal{G} first recovers the scene geometry and camera poses from the unposed input views 𝒱 \mathcal{V} : 𝒢 ⁡ ( 𝒱 ) = ( 𝒵 , 𝒫 ) , \mathcal{G}(\mathcal{V})=(\mathcal{Z},\mathcal{P}), (3) where 𝒵 \mathcal{Z} denotes the reconstructed scene as a point cloud and 𝒫 = { p i } i = 1 N \mathcal{P}=\{p_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} the estimated camera poses.
The planned action Δ ​ v \Delta v is then deterministically mapped to a 6-DoF camera transformation relative to the reference view pose p r p_{r} in this gravity-aligned reconstruction, with the scene geometry providing the scale required to instantiate its coarse magnitude.
Reprojecting the point cloud from the resulting target pose gives the synthesized view: v s = ℛ ⁡ ( 𝒵 , p r ⊕ Δ ​ v ) , v_{s}=\mathcal{R}\left(\mathcal{Z},p_{r}\oplus\Delta v\right), (4) where ℛ \mathcal{R} denotes the reprojection operator and ⊕ \oplus the relative camera transformation induced by Δ ​ v \Delta v .
Since v s v_{s} only rearranges pixels observed in the input views, scene surfaces not covered by any input view remain empty, so the synthesized view supplements rather than replaces the input observations.
More implementation details of view synthesis are provided in the Appendix.

blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. We evaluate Vantage on six VLMs for a wide range of model sizes, i.e . , GPT-5.4 [ 28 ] , Gemma-4-31B [ 33 ] , Qwen3.6-27B [ 30 ] , InternVL3-8B [ 57 ] , Qwen3-VL-8B, and Qwen3-VL-4B [ 42 ] .
For the open-source models, we run inference using vLLM [ 22 ] under the official configurations with two NVIDIA H200 GPUs.
We employ G3T [ 18 ] as the default 3D foundation model (3DFM) for gravity-aligned scene reconstruction and camera pose estimation, and deploy it on the same two GPUs.
blocks.zh:
执行细节。 我们评价了万塔奇六个VLM,用于多种型号大小,即:GPT-5.4 [28],Gemma-4-31B [33],Qun3.6-27B [30],InternVL3-8B [57],Qun3-VL-8B,和Qun3-VL-4B [42].
对于开源模型,我们使用由两个NVIDIA H200 GPU组成的正版配置下的vLLM[22]进行推论.
我们使用G3T [18]作为重力相通场景再造和相机的默认3D基础模型(3DFM)来进行估计,并将其部署在同一两个GPU上.

blocks.en:
Benchmarks. We primarily evaluate on multi-view spatial VQA in static scenes, excluding tasks that involve temporal dynamics or simulated environments.
Our main evaluation covers MindCube-tiny [ 39 ] , the Positional Relationship and Attribute subsets of MMSI-Bench [ 44 ] , and the Multi-view Reasoning subset of BLINK [ 9 ] .
To evaluate the broader applicability of the Seek-and-View paradigm,
we additionally include the Perspective Taking subset of OmniSpatial [ 16 ] for single-view spatial understanding, and the Dynamic Rotation and Dynamic Translation subsets of SPINBench [ 53 ] , where objects or subjects rotate or translate while the background scene remains static.

我们的主要评价涵盖MindCube-tiny [39],MMSI-Bench的定位关系和属性子集[44],以及BLINK的多视图理性子集[9].
为了评估 " 寻求和观察 " 范式的广泛适用性,
我们还包括了用于单视空间理解的OmniSpatial [16] 的“视角”子集,以及SPIN Bench [53] 的动态旋转和动态翻译子集,其中物体或主体旋转或翻译时背景场景保持静态.

blocks.en:
We compare with the state-of-the-art methods [ 1 , 5 ] on three multi-view benchmarks.
Following the evaluation protocols of prior work [ 39 , 5 ] , we report accuracy (%) for each subset and the average accuracy (%) across subsets.
Unless otherwise specified, all evaluations use the benchmark subsets described above.
Details on each benchmark are provided in the Appendix.

我们比较了三种多视角基准上最先进的方法[1,5].

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1: Main results on five benchmarks. For each base model, the better result is shown in bold . The final two columns report the average accuracy across all five benchmarks and the relative improvement. † Results are reported as in their original papers.
blocks.zh: 表1:五项基准的主要结果。 对于每个基准模型,更好的结果以粗体表示。 最后两栏报告所有五个基准的平均准确性和相对改善情况。 页:1 结果按原始文件报告。

blocks.en:
Consistent Gains Across Benchmarks. Table 1 shows that Vantage consistently improves the average accuracy of all six VLMs without additional training.
The gains extend to strong base performance, with Qwen3.6-27B improving from 90.5% to 93.5% on the MindCube-tiny Rotation subset.
More substantial gains are observed when cross-view reasoning remains challenging, as Gemma-4-31B improves from 51.0% to 82.0% on the same subset.
Beyond the multi-view benchmarks, Vantage also improves five of the six models on OmniSpatial, where viewpoint adjustment can expose inferred 3D structures through parallax and provide auxiliary depth cues.
On the dynamic SPINBench subsets, Vantage improves four of the six models, suggesting that the sought view helps to provide spatial cues for object-motion reasoning.
Overall, these results demonstrate the consistent benefits of Vantage through viewpoint-grounded reasoning and geometry-grounded evidence augmentation to enhance the spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh:
贯穿基准的一致收益。 表1显示,万塔奇在未接受额外培训的情况下,不断提高所有6个VLM的平均准确度.
收益扩展到强基性能,在MindCube-tiny旋转子集上,Quen3.6-27B从90.5%提高到93.5%.
当交叉视角推理仍然具有挑战性时,观察到更显著的进展,因为Gemma-4-31B在同一子集上从51.0%提高到82.0%.
在多视图基准之外,万塔奇还改进了OmniSpatial上的6个模型中的5个,在那里,视角调整可以通过parallax来暴露推断出3D结构,并提供辅助深度提示.
在动态SPIN Bench子集上,万塔奇改进了6个模型中的4个,暗示所寻求的视图有助于为物体运动推理提供空间提示.
总体而言,这些结果通过基于观点的推理和以几何为根据的证据增强空间推理,证明了万塔奇的一贯好处.

blocks.en:
Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods. We also compare with state-of-the-art methods on three multi-view benchmarks.
These approaches achieve strong performance through either extensive spatial-task training or tool-integrated agents built on substantially larger VLMs.
In contrast, Vantage achieves its improvements with a training-free and diagnostic pipeline, reaching comparable or superior performance on several subsets without scaling task-specific training or model capacity for reliable tool calling.
This highlights the potential of Seek-and-View as a complementary direction for advancing multi-view spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh:
与"最先进的方法"比较. 我们还在三个多视角基准上与最新方法进行比较。
这些方法通过广泛的空间任务培训或基于大得多的甚高频的工具综合剂来取得强有力的效果。
相形之下,万塔奇通过免费培训和诊断管道实现改进,在几个子集上达到可比或优异的性能,而没有扩大针对特定任务的培训或可靠的工具调用模型能力.
这凸显出探索与视觉作为推进多视角空间推理的补充方向的潜力.

blocks.en:
Analysis and Planning Are Critical to Seek-and-View. The gains vary across models and do not increase monotonically with model size.
To study further into this behavior, we compose the two steps in Stage 1, i.e . , question analysis and view planning, using different model sources, while keeping Stage 2 unchanged.
As shown in Table 2 , the additional gains for the two smaller models depend strongly on the quality of question analysis and view planning, particularly for Qwen3-VL-8B.
Directly replacing both steps with outputs from the larger Qwen3.6-27B does not always yield the best performance.
Instead, stronger results are obtained often when the smaller model performs view planning based on the question analysis by Qwen3.6-27B.
This suggests that the camera action and reasoning guidance should be aligned with the reasoning needs of the model for final VQA.

分析和规划是寻求和观察的关键。 收益因模型而异,不会单调地随着模型大小而增加.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We evaluate the design of Vantage through ablations of its question analysis step, action interface, and final VQA context.
Reconstruction backend comparisons are provided in the Appendix.

我们通过整理其问题分析步骤、行动界面和最后的VQA背景来评价万塔奇的设计。

blocks.en:
Role of the Question Analysis. As shown in Table 4 , we compare the full pipeline with QA-skip , which plans the view without question analysis, and QA-only , which uses question analysis alone to augment the final VQA.
For Qwen3-VL-4B, removing QA reduces accuracy from 38.9% to 30.0% on MindCube-tiny and from 33.7% to 26.8% on MMSI-Bench.
Although QA alone improves over the baseline in several cases, Vantage outperforms both variants in most settings.
This indicates that the QA step supports both view seeking and subsequent final reasoning.
blocks.zh:
问题分析的作用。 如表4所示,我们将整个管道与QA-skip比较,后者计划了不作问题分析的视图,而QA-只使用问题分析来扩充最终的VQA.
对于Quen3-VL-4B,去除QA后,将MindCube-tiny上的精度从38.9%降低到30.0%,将MMSI-Bench上的精度从33.7%降低到26.8%.
虽然单凭质量保证在几个情况下比基线有所改善,但万塔奇在大多数情况下都优于这两个变体.
这表明质量保证步骤既支持寻求观点,也支持随后的最终推理.

blocks.en:
Role of the Action Interface. Table 4 compares alternative strategies for determining the viewpoint.
The 6-DoF variant directly predicts a numerical camera pose, the random variant samples from the predefined action set, and view interpolation synthesizes an intermediate observation between neighboring views.
Across all four models, 6-DoF prediction underperforms our action-selection interface, while random actions and view interpolation provide limited gains overall.
Notably, view interpolation only surpasses our method for Qwen3-VL-8B.
These results support structured action selection as a more reliable interface between semantic planning and executable camera motion, and suggest that the gains of Seek-and-View come from seeking question-relevant viewpoints rather than simply adding denser or more continuous observations.
blocks.zh:
行动界面的作用。 表4比较了确定观点的其他战略。
6-DoF变体直接预测出一个数值相机所摆出的位置,从预定义的动作集中随机的变体样本,并查看插图合成了相邻视图之间的中间观测.
在所有四个模型中,6-DoF预测的性能都低于我们的动作-选择界面,而随机动作和收视插值总体提供的收益有限.
值得注意的是,视图插值只超过我们对Qune3-VL-8B的方法。
这些结果支持结构化的动作选择,作为语义规划和可执行相机运动之间的更可靠的接口,并暗示"Seek-and-View"的收益来自于寻求与问题相关的观点,而不是简单地添加更密集或更连续的观测.

Role of the Visual and Textual Context. Table 5 examines how the synthesized view v s v_{s} , question analysis c ana c_{\mathrm{ana}} , and reasoning guidance c guide c_{\mathrm{guide}} contribute to the final VQA step.
All preceding steps are kept fixed, with only the context supplied to the final VQA being varied.
Using the synthesized view alone improves the average accuracy across the three benchmarks for all four models.
Combining the view with textual context generally yields further gains, while the full combination consistently outperforms the setting using only question analysis and reasoning guidance (row 2).
These results indicate that visual and textual context play complementary roles: the synthesized view provides additional spatial evidence, while the analysis and guidance preserve the observation objective and help the model interpret this evidence during the final reasoning.

blocks.en: 4.4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.4 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Our training-free model-agnostic framework enables a diagnostic analysis of where current VLMs + Seek-and-View still fail.
We audit 600 incorrect predictions across four models and three multi-view benchmarks.
Figure 3 summarizes the estimated prevalence of different failure types and representative cases.
Detailed categorization and estimation procedures are provided in the Appendix.
blocks.zh:
我们的无培训模型-不可知性框架能够对当前VLM + Exe-和-View仍然失败的地方进行诊断分析。
我们审计了对四个模型和三个多视角基准的600个不正确的预测。
图3概述了不同故障类型和代表性病例的估计流行率。
附录载有详细的分类和估计程序。

blocks.en:
What Limits View Seeking? The dominant failures arise in the viewpoint-grounded reasoning stage. Incorrect analysis and incorrect view plan together account for most residual errors, indicating that deciding what should be seen and how to reach it remains the main bottleneck.
As illustrated in Figure 3 (right), these failures reflect errors in analyzing the spatial context or in translating a valid observation need into an executable camera action.
These results suggest that effective viewpoint seeking depends on both accurate question interpretation and reliable grounding from semantic intent to geometric action. This trend is further supported by the cross-source results in Table 2 .
blocks.zh:
搜索什么限制视图 ? 主要的失败发生在基于观点的推理阶段。 分析不正确和观点不正确的计划共同造成大多数剩余错误,表明决定应当看到什么以及如何达到这些错误仍然是主要的瓶颈。
如图3(右)所示,这些失败反映了分析空间上下文或将有效的观测需要转化为可执行相机动作时出错.
这些结果表明,寻求有效观点既取决于准确的问题解释,也取决于从语义意图到几何动作的可靠依据。 这一趋势还得到表2中跨来源结果的进一步支持。

blocks.en:
What Limits Reasoning from the Sought View? Failures at this stage mainly arise from unreliable synthesis or reasoning failure .
Unreliable synthesis is rare and mostly occurs under challenging visual conditions, such as reflections, transparency, severe occlusion, close-up views, darkness, blur, or low resolution.
This suggests that Seek-and-View tolerates imperfect rendering, as long as the synthesized view preserves sufficient geometric and semantic evidence for reasoning.
Reasoning failures occur when the final VLM under-utilizes useful evidence in the sought view or produces an inconsistent reasoning trace.
Thus, the sought view provides additional visual evidence to support cross-view alignment, while reliable spatial reasoning remains necessary for accurate answering.
blocks.zh:
什么样的限制 从Sought景点看的原因? 现阶段的失败主要出自不可靠的合成或推理失败。
不可信赖的合成是罕见的,并且大多发生在挑战性的视觉条件下,如反射,透明,严重隐蔽,特写取景,黑暗,模糊,或低分辨率.
这表明Develop-and-View可以容忍不完美的渲染,只要被合成的视图保留了足够的几何和语义证据用于推理.
当最终的VLM在所寻求的观点中未充分利用有用的证据或产生不一致的推理痕迹时,就会出现合理失败.
因此,所寻求的观点提供了更多的视觉证据来支持交叉视线的对接,而可靠的空间推理对于准确的回答仍然是必要的.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We formulated Seek-and-View, a new reasoning paradigm that seeks question-relevant viewpoints to make spatial evidence distributed across views more directly observable.
This paradigm alleviates the burden on semantic textual reasoning for global scene understanding through question-relevant, evidence-seeking and reasoning-oriented visual evidence acquisition.
To instantiate Seek-and-View, we proposed Vantage, which integrates a VLM with a 3D foundation model through a viewpoint-grounded reasoning stage and a geometry-grounded evidence augmentation stage.
Across five benchmarks and six VLMs, this training-free and model-agnostic framework consistently improves spatial reasoning.
The results suggest that more robust multi-view spatial understanding does not always require strengthening reasoning over fixed observations; rather, seeking question-relevant visual evidence supports cross-view alignment and enhances subsequent reasoning.
blocks.zh:
我们制定了“探索与观察”这一新的推理范式,寻求与问题有关的观点,以便更直接地观察在各种观点中传播的空间证据。
这种范式通过与问题相关、寻找证据和以推理为导向的视觉证据的获取,减轻了语义文字推理对全球场景理解的负担。
为了即兴发挥探索与视觉的作用,我们提出了"万塔奇"(Vantage),它通过一个有视角基础的推理阶段和一个有几何基础的证据增强阶段,将VLM和3D基础模型融合在一起.
在五个基准和六个虚拟LM中,这个无培训和模型不可知性框架不断改进空间推理。
结果表明,更强的多视图空间理解并不总是需要比固定观测加强推理;相反,寻求与问题相关的视觉证据支持交叉视图的对接并增强后续推理.

blocks.en:
Limitation & Future work. As a training-free framework, Vantage may yield rollouts of varying quality depending on the capabilities of the underlying VLM and 3DFM.
Future work could leverage high-quality rollouts for end-to-end optimization toward more reliable spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh:
限制和今后的工作。 作为无培训框架,万塔奇可能根据基本VLM和3DFM的能力推出不同质量的产品。
今后的工作可以借助高质量的推广,实现更可靠的空间推理的端到端优化。

blocks.en: A.1 Action Set for View Planning
blocks.zh: A.1 视图规划行动集

blocks.en:
We provide the complete action set used for view planning in Table 6 , together with the corresponding magnitude levels.
We adopt the camera convention + yaw +\mathrm{yaw} for leftward rotation, + pitch +\mathrm{pitch} for upward tilt, and + x +x , + y +y , and + z +z for rightward, downward, and forward translation, respectively.
Rotation actions modify only the viewing direction, whereas translation actions move the camera by a distance specified in scene units.
For hybrid transformations, orbit actions rotate the camera around the centroid of the reconstructed point cloud, while bird’s-eye and worm’s-eye views introduce additional pitch rotations to obtain elevated or lowered viewpoints.
Since the reconstructed point cloud is not metrically scaled, absolute translation distances are not directly transferable across scenes.
We therefore define one scene unit s s as the mean Euclidean distance from the reference camera center to the remaining input camera centers, providing a scene-adaptive scale that reflects the spatial spread of the observed viewpoints.
blocks.zh:
我们提供了表6中用于查看规划的整套行动以及相应的规模。
我们采用相机常规 + yaw + mathrm{yaw} 左向旋转, + 发音 + mathrm{pitch} 向上倾斜, + × + x , + y + y, 和 + z + z 分别向上,向下, 和向后翻译 。
旋转动作只修改取景方向,而翻译动作则会以场景单位指定的距离来移动相机.
对于杂交变换,轨道动作会将相机围绕被重建的点云的圆心旋转,而鸟眼和蠕虫眼的视角则会引入额外的投出回旋来得到高或更低的视角.
由于已重建的点云没有被平面缩放,绝对翻译距离不能直接跨场相传.
因此,我们将一个场景单位 s 定义为从参考相机中心到其余输入相机中心的平均欧几利得距离,提供一个场景适应尺度,反映观测到的观点的空间分布.

blocks.en: A.2 View Synthesis Pipeline
blocks.zh: A.2 视图合成管道

blocks.en:
Given the target camera extrinsics determined above, we further specify the camera intrinsics for view synthesis.
In particular, the field of view (FoV) is chosen to preserve sufficient scene coverage after the planned camera transformation.
For rotation and translation actions, we use a fixed FoV of 120 ∘ 120^{\circ} to provide a sufficiently wide observation.
For hybrid transformations, which can substantially change the camera position relative to the scene, we adapt the FoV to maintain coverage of the reconstructed scene.
For example, a bird’s-eye transformation may change the apparent scale of a compact scene, and the FoV is adjusted accordingly to retain informative coverage.
The output follows the aspect ratio of the reference view, while reprojection is performed at twice the target width and height before downsampling to the resolution of the reference view.
blocks.zh:
鉴于上面确定的目标相机外观,我们进一步具体规定了用于取景合成的相机内在内容.
特别是,选择取景地(FoV)是为了在计划相机转换后保持足够的场景覆盖.
对于旋转和翻译动作,我们使用120分之120分之120分之120分之120分之一的固定FOV来提供足够广泛的观察.
对于可大幅改变相机相对于场景位置的混合变相,我们改造了FOV以保持被重建场景的覆盖.
例如,鸟眼的转变可能会改变紧凑场景的明显规模,FOV也相应被调整以保留信息覆盖.
输出遵循了参考视图的外观比,而再投影则在向参考视图分辨率下取样前以目标宽度和高度的两倍进行.

blocks.en: Table 7 illustrate the effect of the FoV while keeping the upstream viewpoint-grounded reasoning fixed. This suggests that FoV affects how much spatial context can be captured within the synthesized view, which is particularly important for complex real-world scenes where relevant evidence may span a broader spatial region.

Reconstruction Backend. Table 8 compares G3T [ 18 ] with VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 37 ] combined with GeoCalib [ 34 ] , representing two routes to the gravity-aligned reconstruction required by our action interface.
G3T directly produces a gravity-aligned reconstruction, whereas the alternative first reconstructs the scene with VGGT- Ω \Omega and then uses GeoCalib on the reference view to estimate the gravity direction for alignment.

blocks.en:
MindCube evaluates spatial mental modeling from limited multi-view observations, covering spatial relations that require reasoning about object positions, orientations, and hypothetical viewpoint changes [ 39 ] .
We evaluate on the MindCube-tiny split and report its Rotation, Among, and Around subsets.
blocks.zh:
MindCube从有限的多视图观测中评价空间心智模型,涵盖空间关系,需要就物体位置,取向,和假设观点变化进行推理[39].
我们评估MindCube-tiny的分裂 并报告它的旋转, 中间和周围子集。

blocks.en:
MMSI-Bench evaluates multi-view spatial intelligence over real-world scenes, covering positional relations among cameras, objects, and regions, as well as attribute, motion, and multi-step reasoning [ 44 ] .
We focus on the subsets centered on static multi-view spatial reasoning and exclude the Motion and Multi-Step Reasoning subsets. The former involves temporal changes across observations, while the latter places greater emphasis on compositional reasoning over multiple spatial steps.
Both introduce additional reasoning factors beyond the setting targeted by Seek-and-View, which focuses on seeking question-relevant visual evidence when spatial information is fragmented across sparse observations or difficult to express and resolve through language alone.
blocks.zh:
MMSI-Bench在现实世界场景上评价多视空间智能,涵盖相机,物体,和地区之间的位置关系,以及属性,运动,和多步推理[44].
我们专注于以静态多视空间推理为中心的子集,并排除了"运动"和"多步理性"子集. 前者涉及跨观测的时间变化,而后者则更强调多个空间步骤的构成推理.
两者都引入了超出Develop-and-View目标设定的额外推理因素,其重点是在空间信息分散于稀少的观测中或难以仅通过语言表达和解决时寻找与问题有关的视觉证据.

blocks.en:
BLINK is a diagnostic benchmark covering wide perception-demanding visual tasks, including multi-view reasoning, relative depth, visual correspondence, and spatial relations [ 9 ] .
We use only its Multi-view Reasoning subset, which requires reasoning across observations from different viewpoints and is therefore most aligned with our multi-view spatial setting.
blocks.zh:
BLINK是一个诊断性基准,涵盖广感-需求视觉任务,包括多视角推理,相对深度,视觉通信,和空间关系[9].
我们只使用它的多视角理性子集,这需要从不同的观点进行跨观测的推理,因此最符合我们的多视角空间环境.

blocks.en:
OmniSpatial evaluates spatial reasoning across four broad dimensions: dynamic reasoning, complex spatial logic, spatial interaction, and perspective taking [ 16 ] .
We include only the Perspective Taking subset, which evaluates egocentric, allocentric, and hypothetical viewpoint reasoning from a single observed scene.
The remaining categories primarily emphasize temporal dynamics, interaction and planning, or abstract geometric and pattern reasoning, and are not designed around multi-view observations of real-world scenes.
blocks.zh:
OmniSpatial评价空间推理跨越了四个广泛的维度:动态推理,复杂的空间逻辑,空间相互作用,以及视角取景[16].
我们只包括"视角取取子集"(Perspective Gooking special),它评价自负心,同心同德,以及假设的观点推理从一个被观察到的场景中推导出来.
其余类别主要强调时间动态,互动和规划,或抽象几何和图案推理,并非围绕着现实世界场景的多景观测来设计.

blocks.en:
SPINBench is a diagnostic benchmark for spatial reasoning under perspective and geometric transformations, covering translation, rotation, relative pose, and viewpoint change [ 53 ] .
We additionally evaluate on the Dynamic Rotation and Dynamic Translation subsets, where an object or subject undergoes controlled rotation or translation while the surrounding scene largely remains static.
These subsets provide a limited extension beyond our core static multi-view setting by testing whether Seek-and-View can also support spatial reasoning when the queried entity itself changes pose or position.
blocks.zh:
SPIN Bench是视角和几何转换下空间推理的诊断基准,涵盖翻译,旋转,相对姿势,和视角变化[53].
我们还对动态旋转和动态翻译子集进行了评价,在一个对象或主体进行有控制的旋转或翻译时,周围的场景基本上保持静态.
这些子集提供了超出我们核心静态多视图设置的有限扩展,通过测试被询问实体本身改变所构成或位置时,Defe-and-View是否可以也支持空间推理.

We randomly sample 50 incorrect predictions for each of four models on each of three multi-view benchmarks, yielding 600 annotated cases in total.
Each case is assigned to one of five failure categories: Incorrect analysis , Incorrect view plan , Unreliable synthesis , Reasoning failure , or Format error .

Verify the observation gap from the reference viewpoint . 2. Identify the missing evidence and query region . 3. Determine the observation principle required to reveal the evidence . 4. Compose a spatial - clue narrative that : ( a ) predicts , at a high level , the geometric form the new view will take , ( b ) grounds each input view relevant to the question with observable orientation cues and background / scene anchors , ( c ) sets up the cross - view correspondences the reasoner needs to combine , without combining them . **[ OUTPUT FORMAT ]** Return a single JSON object wrapped in “‘ json … “‘. “‘ json { ” reasoning ”: ”…”, ” missing_evidence ”: ”…”, ” observation_principle ”: ”…”, ” reference_view ”: ”…”, ” pose ”: ”< one of pan_left , pan_right , tilt_up , tilt_down , turn_around , move_forward , move_backward , move_left , move_right , pedestal_up , pedestal_down , orbit_left , orbit_right , orbit_up , orbit_down , birds_eye_view , worms_eye_view >”, ” magnitude ”: ”< one of small , medium , large >”, ” reasoning guidance ”: ”…” } “‘ **[ FIELD DEFINITIONS ]** - reasoning : verify the stage -1 analysis with the question from the reference viewpoint , using within - view evidence only ; do not relate input views to each other here . - missing_evidence : Based on the ’ target_information ’, identify the specific evidence that is unavailable from the reference viewpoint . Examples : - object immediately left of the chair - background hidden behind the cabinet - relative depth ordering among nearby objects - surrounding scene layout or need the entire scene overview - target object / view after the camera action instruction ( e . g ., turn left and move forward ) from the question - reference_view : The verified reference viewpoint from the stage -1 analysis . - observation_principle : Determine what visual cue would reveal the missing evidence . Examples : - expose out - of - view content - reveal obstructed object / background / region - maintain anchor visibility while changing viewpoint - reveal global scene layout - follow the rotation instruction ( e . g ., turn left ) to inspect the target object / view - pose : Choose the pose that best realizes the observation principle . Do NOT estimate metric distances . - reasoning guidance : A spatial - clue narrative for the downstream reasoner . Write ONE paragraph composed of the three parts below , in order . The reasoner will see the input views , the original question , the newly rendered view , the stage -1 analysis and this reasoning guidance . Describe only the viewing geometry ; do NOT invent the specific content , objects , or spatial layout that will appear . (2) Input - view anchors (*\ textemdash {}*) for EACH input view the question actually relies on , state as OBSERVABLE FACTS about that input image : its dominant scene - facing direction and one or two background / scene anchors that identify what it is looking at ( e . g ., ” image 1 faces the wall with the whiteboard , with the desk on its right edge ”, ” image 2 faces the kitchen counter , with a window on its left edge ”).
